statements.dead:
SELECT q.id, q.attempts, COALESCE(q.last_error, ''),
  strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', q.updated_at),
  json_object('order_id', q."order_id", 'placed_at', q."placed_at", 'priority', q."priority", 'quantity', q."quantity", 'note', q."note", 'ship_to', CASE WHEN json_valid(q."ship_to") THEN json(q."ship_to") ELSE q."ship_to" END, 'tags', CASE WHEN json_valid(q."tags") THEN json(q."tags") ELSE q."tags" END),
  count(*) OVER ()
FROM order_placed_queue AS q
WHERE q.state = 'dead'
ORDER BY q.updated_at, q.id
LIMIT ?1
statements.states:
SELECT q.id, CASE WHEN q.id IN (SELECT id FROM order_placed_queue WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))) THEN '' ELSE q.state END
FROM order_placed_queue AS q WHERE q.id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
statements.retry:
UPDATE order_placed_queue SET state = 'ready', attempts = 0, due_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), claim_token = NULL, claim_expires_at = NULL, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM order_placed_queue WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)))) = json_array_length(?1)
RETURNING id
statements.retryAll:

statements.drop:
DELETE FROM order_placed_queue
WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM order_placed_queue WHERE state = 'dead' AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1)))) = json_array_length(?1)
RETURNING id
